title: TTL-aware custody store eviction
description: Replace simple oldest-first eviction in custody/store-and-forward buffers with TTL-aware policy: (1) expired first, (2) least remaining TTL (msg.expiry - now()), (3) per-destination fairness, (4) FIFO tiebreaker. A message with 5 minutes remaining is worth less storage than one with 23 hours remaining regardless of arrival order. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.8 eviction policy. All three impls. Depends on: custody message store (ldhl.3).
